svg.title: Orbin shared TikTok-style Home preview
svg.desc: Screenshot-style illustration of Orbin 195 Bitter Melon showing the current vertical Home feed, source-aware actions, and fixed five-position navigation. The embedded PNG is an unmodified 390 by 844 shared-UI fixture rendered by the Android host in iOS mode with local artwork; it is not a native iOS device screenshot.
